description: Header file defining the BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl class, which implements SPDY protocol stream handling with methods for starting streams, sending headers and data, and handling stream events.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl
classes.description: Implements SPDY-based bidirectional stream with methods for managing stream lifecycle, data transfer, and event handling.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the SPDY stream with request info, logging, delegate, timer, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends the request headers over the SPDY stream.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into the provided buffer.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers as data over the stream, with optional end stream flag.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol for the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the stream.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the stream.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details if available.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Callback when early hints are received.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Callback when response headers are received.

methods.name: OnDataSent
methods.description: Callback when data has been sent.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if frame type can be greased.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.
